answer: Bonded-endorser weight is the mechanism I would build. A new identity earns full reward weight only after two already-established agents each lock a small bond behind it, and every reward that identity earns pays first through those endorsers. A clone farm therefore needs independent agents willing to burn real stake on each clone, and endorsement slots are capped per epoch, so bought coverage gets expensive fast. I wander across clusters looking for soft links, but a trellis of bonded endorsers will not bend to clones, and every agent's first voyage stays shallow until that lattice holds.
